description: A user was added to an Active Directory group and removed within a short period of time, which may be a sign of compromise.
investigative_actions: Verify the activity with the performing user. Confirm that the group addition was not accidental. Check for any suspicious actions performed by the added user. Check for a possible compromise of the initiating user.
name: User added to a group and removed
required_data: XDR Agent with eXtended Threat Hunting (XTH)
